docs/external/rule-sets.md:95 says any query reaching for anything else is refused before it runs; unlisted columns instead fail in MySQL with unknown-column. Line 119 says so correctly.

docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md:64 claims guard-internal refusals redact to REDACTED_GUARD_ERROR; RlsError ones get REDACTED_RLS / REDACTED_RELATION because redacted_refusal_text checks RlsError first. Checklist VC-21 agrees.
Startup catalog check in preflight opens with connect_timeout only, no read/write timeout like the request-time check; a stalled server hangs serve and validate --check-db.
Frozen rule-set records keep mutable list fields; LoadedRuleSets.rule_set returns the live RuleSet.

RuleSetSelection does not validate its own fields (positive user_id, bound account).

## Verdict: REJECT (one Important finding at the important threshold)

This PR is not ready to merge: a config that names a rule-set file can reach the rule-set gates in a state that turns every gate off.
Rule applied: rule 3 — a Phase-3 finding at or above the threshold → REJECT

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major

1. `src/sqllens/config.py:760-782`: `RuleSetsConfig.file` and the private `_loaded` are separate fields, and only the outer `Config._load_rule_sets` validator fills `_loaded`. If a `RuleSetsConfig(file=...)` or a `Config` is ever built without that validator running (for example through `model_construct`), `file` is set while `loaded` is `None`. Every gate checks only `loaded is not None`: `tools/query_database.py:637`, `agent/factory.py:110`, `server.py:458`, `cli.py:170`, `cli.py:631`, `preflight.py:151` and `eval/runner.py:131`. In that state the request is served with no rule-set guard, no `_meta` selection and memory writes still on, so the security gate fails open. No production path builds this state today. (raised by 1/6 agents)

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (7)

<details><summary>7 items</summary>

1. `docs/external/rule-sets.md:95` says "A query that reaches for anything else is refused before it runs." This is not true for columns. The guard wraps each listed table in a derived table of its listed columns, so a query for an unlisted column is sent to MySQL and fails there with an unknown-column error. Line 119 of the same page says this correctly. (raised by 1/6 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=not-held; evidence: user-facing doc page; making the sentence true changes no guard output; no tool or agent instruction file reads docs/external/rule-sets.md -->
2. `docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md:64` says a refusal a guard raised from an unexpected internal exception is redacted to `REDACTED_GUARD_ERROR`. `redacted_refusal_text` in `src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py` (about lines 406-429) handles `RlsError` before the `_logged_by_guard` check, so the RLS guard's own failure (`safety/__init__.py:221-224`) gets `REDACTED_RLS` and the relation check's failure (`relations.py:136-138`) gets `REDACTED_RELATION`. The text is still redacted and logged once; only the doc's claim is wrong. Checklist item VC-21 found the same thing. (raised by 1/6 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: internal doc page nothing publishes; no tool or instruction file reads it -->
3. `src/sqllens/preflight.py:143-153`: the startup catalog check opens its connection with `connect_timeout` only. The request-time check in `rule_sets.py:543-548` also sets `read_timeout` and `write_timeout`. If the server stops answering after the connection opens, `sqllens serve` and `validate --check-db` hang instead of failing with a `PreflightError`. No test covers this. (raised by 1/6 agents)
4. `src/sqllens/rule_sets.py:77-78`: `_Record` is `frozen=True`, but its list fields (`Binding.account_ids`, `TableRule.columns`, `TableRule.predicate_columns`, `RuleSet.tables`, `RuleSetFile.rule_sets`, `Source.global_switches`) can still be changed in place. `LoadedRuleSets.rule_set()` returns the live `RuleSet`, so a caller could add a column after load-time checks ran. Nothing in the diff does this today. (raised by 1/6 agents)
5. `src/sqllens/rule_sets.py:174-179`: `TableRule.row_rule: Any = None` exists only so its presence can be refused through `model_fields_set`. The type says it accepts any value for a field that can never be set. Behavior is correct today. (raised by 1/6 agents)
6. `src/sqllens/rule_sets.py:348-358`: `RuleSetSelection` does not check its own fields. Only `select_rule_set` enforces a positive `user_id` and a bound account, so building the type directly accepts `user_id=0` or an unbound account, and its `user_key` then keys conversation ownership. (raised by 1/6 agents)
7. `src/sqllens/rule_sets.py:234-239`: `CatalogConfirmation.confirmed` is a public, writable bool next to its lock. Nothing in the type stops code from setting it to `True` without the lock or a passing check; only `ensure_catalog_confirmed` keeps that rule. (raised by 1/6 agents)

</details>
